name: jev-harness

author: jev-harness contributors

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: TypeSafe Jev model name. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL.

destructiveThreshold.title: Destructive threshold

skillConfidence.title: Skill confidence
skillConfidence.description: Minimum Jev confidence before the UserPromptSubmit hook suggests a skill.
